evidence: the increasing sophistication of cybersecurity threats, coupled with the adoption of emerging technologies such as artificial intelligence (AI), automation, and cloud-based platforms, poses important risks to our operations, financial performance, and reputation
In November 2025, we implemented an enterprise-wide Artificial Intelligence Standard that governs AI adoption and use, model lifecycle management, and associated cybersecurity and privacy controls
Cybersecurity and the secure adoption of emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence ('AI'), remain strategic priorities for Newmont
We continuously invest in developing our cybersecurity controls and processes to address these threats and reduce the risk of future breaches and cyber attacks
ai_positioning.summary: Newmont adopte une posture défensive face à l'IA, mettant l'accent sur la gestion des risques cybersécurité et la conformité plutôt que sur l'innovation. L'entreprise a mis en place un standard d'IA d'entreprise en novembre 2025 pour encadrer l'adoption sécurisée de la technologie.
